const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboWits stack_cubes controller, eai-standard/2.2.
+
+This records the calibrated pick/place sequence used for the episode.  Run one
+phase at a time so the camera can be checked after each pick/place:
+
+  python /app/output/gen.py --phase pick-a
+  python /app/output/gen.py --phase place-a
+  python /app/output/gen.py --phase pick-b
+  python /app/output/gen.py --phase place-b
+  python /app/output/gen.py --phase pick-red
+  python /app/output/gen.py --phase place-red
+
+All coordinates are world metres.  The ego camera and its depth map locate the
+objects; the service supplies no object poses.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output/episode")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+ROBOT = Robot()
+
+# The top camera's calibrated depth gave table z=0.7566 m and cube-centre
+# z=0.7826 m.  The green-dot centre is approximately (0.4251, 0.1631) m.
+DOWN = np.array([0.0, 2**-0.5, 2**-0.5, 0.0])  # tool +z down, finger axis along world y
+CUBE_Z = 0.7826
+DOT = (0.4251, 0.1631)
+BASE_A = (DOT[0], DOT[1])
+BASE_B = (0.4801, DOT[1])  # 5.5 cm centre spacing gives a small safe gap
+RED_SRC = (0.5337, 0.0011)
+GREY_A_SRC = (0.5404, 0.0593)
+GREY_B_SRC = (0.5846, 0.2359)
+RED_Z = CUBE_Z + 0.0500
+
+
+def current_pose():
+    obs = ROBOT.get_obs(cameras=["ego"], video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    # tcp_pose is right xyz+quat then left xyz+quat; grippers are joint_pos[7,15].
+    return now[16:30].copy(), float(now[7]), float(now[15])
+
+
+def make_row(side, xyz, grip, other=None):
+    tcp, rg, lg = current_pose()
+    if other is None:
+        other = tcp[7:14].copy() if side == "right" else tcp[:7].copy()
+    active = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), DOWN]
+    if side == "right":
+        return np.r_[active, grip, other, lg]
+    return np.r_[other, rg, active, grip]
+
+
+def record_result(result, tag):
+    stamp = f"{int(time.time())}_{tag}"
+    path = OUT / stamp
+    result.save(str(path))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "saved": str(path),
+        "done": result.meta.get("done"),
+        "reason": result.meta.get("reason"),
+        "control_steps_chunk": result.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+        "executed_rows": result.meta.get("executed_rows"),
+        "plan": result.meta.get("plan"),
+        "status": ROBOT.status(),
+    }, indent=2))
+
+
+def submit_rows(side, points, tag):
+    tcp, rg, lg = current_pose()
+    idle = tcp[7:14].copy() if side == "right" else tcp[:7].copy()
+    rows = []
+    for xyz, grip in points:
+        active = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), DOWN]
+        if side == "right":
+            rows.append(np.r_[active, grip, idle, lg])
+        else:
+            rows.append(np.r_[idle, rg, active, grip])
+    result = ROBOT.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(rows), video="frames",
+                          cameras=["ego", "wrist_left", "wrist_right"],
+                          note=tag)
+    record_result(result, tag)
+    return result
+
+
+def pick(source, tag):
+    x, y = source
+    return submit_rows("left", [
+        ((x, y, 0.9100), 0.090),       # approach above the cube
+        ((x, y, CUBE_Z), 0.090),       # lower the open fingers around its centre
+        ((x, y, CUBE_Z), 0.025),       # close on the 5 cm cube
+        ((x, y, 0.9100), 0.025),       # lift clear of the table
+    ], "pick-" + tag)
+
+
+def place(destination, center_z, tag):
+    x, y = destination
+    return submit_rows("left", [
+        ((x, y, 0.9100), 0.025),       # transport while keeping the cube clear
+        ((x, y, center_z), 0.025),     # lower until the cube is supported
+        ((x, y, center_z), 0.090),     # release
+        ((x, y, 0.9500), 0.090),       # retreat in the same call
+    ], "place-" + tag)
+
+
+PHASES = {
+    "raise": lambda: submit_rows("left", [
+        ((float(current_pose()[0][7]), float(current_pose()[0][8]), 0.950), 0.090)
+    ], "raise-left"),
+    "pick-a": lambda: pick(GREY_A_SRC, "grey-a"),
+    "place-a": lambda: place(BASE_A, CUBE_Z, "grey-a"),
+    "pick-b": lambda: pick(GREY_B_SRC, "grey-b"),
+    "place-b": lambda: place(BASE_B, CUBE_Z, "grey-b"),
+    "pick-red": lambda: pick(RED_SRC, "red"),
+    "place-red": lambda: place(BASE_A, RED_Z, "red"),
+}
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=["status", *PHASES], default="status")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.phase == "status":
+        print(json.dumps(ROBOT.status(), indent=2))
+        obs = ROBOT.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+        from PIL import Image
+        for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+            Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT / f"status_{cam}.png")
+        np.save(OUT / "status_depth_ego.npy", obs.last_depth["ego"])
+        return
+    PHASES[args.phase]()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
